title: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi rajiun
body:
INNA LILLAHI WA INNA ILAYHI RAJI’UN
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un (×2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbo bala k ban me zahra ki ye sada hai
<<MINI>>
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un (×2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Narghe me kufiyoun ke aulad e Murtaza hai
Hamrah shahe dee(n) k namuse Mustafa hai Maidane karbala hai aur mout ki faza hai
<<MINI>>
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un (×2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haathoun me zalimoun k Talwar o teero khanjar
Us simt hain hazaroun is simt hain bahattar
Har aik raahe haq me qurban ho raha hai
<<MINI>>
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un (×2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aun o Moahmmed apne wade nibha gaye hain
Mamu pa hoke qurbaa(n) manzil ko pa gaye hain Zainab k lab lakin shikwa hai na gila hai
<<MINI>>
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un (×2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sarko jhukaye sarwar aansu baha rahe hain
Ibne Hasan k ran me tukde utha rahe hain Ghodoun se jisme Qasim pamal ho gaya hai
<<MINI>>
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un (×2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaimoun se Al Atash ki awaz aarahi hai
Ammu se ab Sakina be aas ho gaee hai
Shane kata k ghazi darya pa so gaya hai
<<MINI>>
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un (×2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kadiyal jawa(n) ka marna Maa Baap ki qaza hai
Laila pa farte gham se sakta sa cha gaya hai Naiza jigar pa kha kar Akber jo chal basa hai
<<MINI>>
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un (×2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Chakkiyan pees kar jis bete ko mai ne pala
Uske gale pa khanjer zalim ne phair dala Aur jism uska ran me pamal kar diya hai
<<MINI>>
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un (×2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Manzer baya(n) Aqeel aur Farhan se ho kaise
Kata gala tha jiska ek teer e Hurmala ne
Masoom wo lahad me phir zibha ho raha hai
<<MINI>>
